note: Phrasings are deliberately written the way a user would ask, not lifted from the skills' description fields. Reusing description wording would make the test circular. Entries marked "hard": true are near-miss negatives added 2026-08-29: each names a test, rate limit, alert threshold or coverage tool, but asks for execution, config or tooling rather than whether to adopt the measure. The original negatives were all off-topic, so they could not detect an over-broad description.
